properties.description: Nine Sols is a lore-rich, hand-drawn 2D action-platformer with Sekiro-inspired, deflection-focused combat. Players control a vengeful hero in an eastern-fantasy setting as they explore a land once home to an ancient alien race and attempt to slay the nine formidable rulers known as the 9 Sols.
properties.short_description: A vengeful hero traverses a hand-drawn eastern-fantasy world to slay nine godlike rulers and uncover the secrets of an ancient alien civilization.

short_descriptions.value: Ein Held begibt sich auf eine Reise, um die Neun Sonnen zu besiegen und die dunklen Geheimnisse eines verfluchten Reiches mit tödlichem Virus zu enthüllen.
Un héroe emprende una misión para derrotar a los Nueve Soles y descubrir los oscuros secretos de un reino abandonado plagado por un virus mortal.
Un héros se lance dans une quête pour vaincre les Neuf Sols et découvrir les sombres secrets d'un royaume abandonné ravagé par un virus mortel.
A hero embarks on a quest to defeat the Nine Sols and uncover the dark secrets of a forsaken realm plagued by a deadly virus.

properties.description: Solve exciting puzzle based on number Three, six, nine Solve different type of puzzles where you have to make sequence in 3,6,9 Based on roman number, drag and drop, music sound, moving blocks, morse code, alphabet, logics, creativity\r\n
properties.short_description: Players engage in a variety of puzzles centered around the numbers three, six, and nine, testing logic and creativity.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler lösen verschiedene Rätsel rund um die Zahlen drei, sechs und neun und testen dabei Logik und Kreativität.
Los jugadores resuelven diversos acertijos centrados en los números tres, seis y nueve, poniendo a prueba su lógica y creatividad.
Les joueurs résolvent divers puzzles centrés sur les nombres trois, six et neuf, testant leur logique et créativité.
Players engage in a variety of puzzles centered around the numbers three, six, and nine, testing logic and creativity.

properties.description: “Massive debt, a shabby brothel, and a naughty succubus… This is all I get for defeating the Demon God?!” Hire monster girls to attract customers and pay off your debts! Don't forget to give your girls lots of hands-on job training!\r\n
properties.short_description: A debt-ridden owner must hire monster girls to attract customers and pay off debts while managing a shabby brothel.

short_descriptions.value: Ein verschuldeter Besitzer muss Monster-Mädchen einstellen, um Kunden anzulocken und Schulden abzuzahlen, während er ein heruntergekommenes Bordell führt.
Un dueño endeudado debe contratar chicas monstruo para atraer clientes y pagar deudas mientras gestiona un burdel deteriorado.
Un propriétaire endetté doit engager des filles monstres pour attirer les clients et rembourser ses dettes tout en gérant un bordel délabré.
A debt-ridden owner must hire monster girls to attract customers and pay off debts while managing a shabby brothel.

properties.description: Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.\r\n
properties.short_description: Manage a professional football team through trades, drafts, and game plans to build a successful franchise over decades.

short_descriptions.value: Verwalte ein professionelles Football-Team durch Trades, Drafts und Spielpläne, um über Jahrzehnte eine erfolgreiche Franchise aufzubauen.
Gestiona un equipo profesional de fútbol americano mediante intercambios, selecciones y estrategias para construir una franquicia exitosa durante décadas.
Gérez une équipe professionnelle de football américain via échanges, drafts et stratégies pour bâtir une franchise prospère sur plusieurs décennies.
Manage a professional football team through trades, drafts, and game plans to build a successful franchise over decades.

properties.description: It's a sandbox cultivation game where players recruit and train talents, build their own homesteads, practice alchemy and crafting, battle monsters and collect materials. The combat mode features automatic side-scrolling battles with companions, meanwhile player can decide cards to execute attacks.\r\n
properties.short_description: Players cultivate their homesteads, train talents, and battle monsters in a magical sandbox world.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler kultivieren ihre Höfe, trainieren Talente und kämpfen gegen Monster in einer magischen Sandbox-Welt.
Los jugadores cultivan sus hogares, entrenan talentos y luchan contra monstruos en un mundo mágico de sandbox.
Les joueurs cultivent leurs fermes, entraînent des talents et combattent des monstres dans un monde bac à sable magique.
Players cultivate their homesteads, train talents, and battle monsters in a magical sandbox world.
